name: A War of Ambition: Under the Banner of Revival
source:
Eran and Theo are friends and mercenaries in the notorious Band of the Sun. Eran is driven by vengeance for his father’s death, while Theo dreams of power and control. 

As loyalties are tested and tragedy strikes, their friendship is pushed to its limits. In a world ruled by ambition and betrayal, can they survive the choices they are forced to make, or will their bond shatter under the weight of their desires?

[From [url=https://ravencrawl.itch.io/a-war-of-ambition]Itch.io[/url]]
